description: This file implements memory-mapped register access functions for the B53 network switch driver in the Linux kernel. It defines functions for reading and writing various data widths (8, 16, 32, 48, 64 bits), includes platform driver setup, and manages device registration and removal.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 * val)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from memory-mapped register space for the B53 device.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value with endianness consideration from memory-mapped register space.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value with endianness consideration from memory-mapped register space.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 48-bit value from memory-mapped register space, combining 16 bits and 32 bits parts.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit value from memory-mapped register space.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 value)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to memory-mapped register space.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value with endianness consideration.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 value)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value with endianness consideration.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 48-bit value split into 16-bit and 32-bit parts.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value to memory-mapped register space.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_probe(struct platform_device * pdev)
methods.description: Probe function for initializing the B53 switch driver on platform device.

methods.name: void b53_mmap_remove(struct platform_device * pdev)
methods.description: Cleanup function for removing the B53 switch driver.
